extracted.intended_audience: issuers, sponsors, depositors, trustees, servicers, underwriters and legal/compliance counsel preparing SEC Regulation AB asset-backed securities disclosures and filings
extracted.subtask_description: Detailed checklist and disclosure requirements under Regulation AB (Items 1111–1121) for registration statements and periodic reports concerning asset-backed securities, covering residual values, representations and warranties, asset-level data, transaction structure, credit enhancement, derivatives, tax, legal proceedings, affiliations, ratings and performance reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Residual value estimation and realization disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: If the pool includes leases or other assets where a portion of the securitized pool balance is attributable to the residual value of the underlying physical property underlying the leases, disclose the following:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: (i) How the residual values used to structure the transaction were estimated, including an explanation of any material discount rates, models or assumptions used and who selected such rates, models or assumptions. (ii) Any material procedures or requirements incorporated to preserve residual values during the term of the lease (lessee responsibilities, prohibitions on subletting, indemnification, required insurance/guarantees). (iii) The procedures by which residual values will be realized and by whom, including experience, affiliations with parties in Item 1119(a), and compensation arrangements. (iv) Whether assets are open-end or closed-end leases and percentage of each if both. (v) To the extent material, any lessor obligations under the leases and the effect of lessor failure to perform. (vi) Statistical information regarding estimated residual values for pool assets. (vii) Summary historical statistics on turn-in rates and residual value realization rates by the responsible party over the past three years or longer if material. (viii) Effect on security holders if insufficient cash flow is received from realized residual values, provisions to address the contingency, and allocation of any excess cash flow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representations and warranties (pool assets)
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize any representations and warranties made concerning the pool assets by the sponsor, transferor, originator or other party to the transaction, and describe briefly the remedies available if those representations and warranties are breached.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include remedies such as repurchase obligations and any other brief description of remedies available upon breach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modification provisions (pool assets)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any provisions in the transaction agreements governing the modification of the terms of any asset.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how such modification may affect the cash flows from the assets or to the securities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims on pool assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any material direct or contingent claim that parties other than the holders of the asset-backed securities have on any pool assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also describe any material cross-collateralization or cross-default provisions relating to the pool assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revolving periods, prefunding accounts and pool asset change disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: If the transaction contemplates a prefunding or revolving period, or other circumstances where pool assets may be added, substituted or removed, provide the applicable information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (1) term/duration of prefunding/revolving period; (2) amount of proceeds to be deposited for prefunding; (3) max amount of additional assets during revolving period; (4) percentage of pool represented by prefunding/revolving account; (5) triggers/events that limit or terminate prefunding/revolving period and effects (describe operation of revolving and amortization periods); (6) when/how new assets may be acquired and how assets may be removed/substituted, including limits on amount/type/speed; (7) acquisition/underwriting criteria for additional assets and differences from current pool criteria; (8) which party has authority to add/remove/substitute assets and whether independent verification of that authority will occur; (9) requirements to add/remove minimum amounts and effects of non-compliance; (10) procedures and standards for temporary investment of funds in such accounts and eligible financial products and disposition of gains/losses; (11) circumstances under which funds will be returned to investors or otherwise disposed; (12) whether and how investors will be notified of changes to the asset pool.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset-level information and filing requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If the asset pool includes certain asset types (residential/commercial mortgages, automobile loans/leases, debt securities or resecuritizations), provide asset-level information as specified in Schedule AL.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: File disclosures as an Asset Data File in the EDGAR Filer Manual format and file as an exhibit to Form ABS-EE per Item 601(b)(102). Registrant may provide additional explanatory disclosure or other asset-level information by filing asset-related documents as exhibits in accordance with Item 601(b)(103); such additional documents must contain definitions and formulas for each additional data point and related tagged data. Instruction: All information required must be provided at the time of every filing for each asset that was in the asset pool during the reporting period, including assets removed prior to period end.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significant obligor disclosures (descriptive and financial)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide descriptive and financial information for each significant obligor of pool assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Descriptive: (1) name of obligor; (2) organizational form and general character of business; (3) nature of concentration of pool assets with the obligor; (4) material terms of pool assets and agreements with the obligor. Financial: If obligor represents >=10% but <20% of pool, provide summarized financial information per Rule 1-02(bb) for last three fiscal years (or life). If obligor represents >=20% of pool, provide financial statements meeting Regulation S-X §§210.1-01 through 210.13-02 (with stated exceptions) and consolidated financials as required. Instructions: No information required under paragraph (b) if obligations are backed by full faith and credit of U.S.; special compliance provisions if significant obligor is an asset-backed issuer; foreign business reconciliation and Form 20-F options as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transaction structure and securities description
rubrics_metrics.description: Address specific factors relating to the asset-backed securities and transaction structure (per Item 202 of Regulation S-K).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (1) types/categories of securities to be offered (interest-weighted, principal-weighted, IO/PO, planned amortization/companion classes, residual/subordinated interests); (2) the flow of funds including payment allocations, rights and distribution priorities among classes (narrative and graphical presentation if helpful); disclose requirements directing cash flows (reserve accounts, cash collateral) and their purpose/operation; (3) explanation of interest rate(s), how determined and frequency, and description of combined-rate scenarios; (4) how principal will be paid including maturity dates, amortization/distribution schedules, formulas and factors affecting timing/amounts for each class; (5) denominations of issuance; (6) specified changes to structure triggered upon default/event of default; (7) liquidation, amortization, performance or similar triggers/events and investor rights or changes to structure/flow of funds if such events occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delinquency threshold for asset representations review
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe how the delinquency threshold that triggers a review by the asset representations reviewer was determined to be appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When describing appropriateness, compare the delinquency threshold against delinquencies disclosed for prior securitized pools of the sponsor for that asset type in accordance with Item 1105.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicer or party compliance evidence requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether the servicer or other party is required to provide periodic evidence of the absence of a default or of compliance with the terms of the transaction agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose frequency, nature of evidence, and any consequences for non-provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overcollateralization / undercollateralization disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, disclose the extent, expressed as a percentage, the transaction is overcollateralized or undercollateralized as measured by comparing the principal balance of the asset-backed securities to the asset pool.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide calculation method and any assumptions used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisions in other securities that could cause cross-default/cross-collateralization
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose any provisions contained in other securities that could result in a cross-default or cross-collateralization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the nature and potential effects on the offered securities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor suitability and ownership/transfer restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose any minimum standards, restrictions or suitability requirements regarding potential investors in purchasing the securities or any restrictions on ownership or transfer of the securities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the standards, restrictions, rationale and enforcement mechanism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security holder voting and allocation of voting rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose the security holder vote required to amend the transaction documents and allocation of voting rights among security holders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include thresholds/percentages and procedures for votes and amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution frequency and cash maintenance
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose the frequency of distribution dates for the asset-backed securities and the collection periods for the pool assets and describe how cash held pending distribution is held and invested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify the length of time cash will be held pending distribution, parties with access to cash balances, authority to invest cash, who determines deposit/transfer/disbursement decisions, and whether independent verification of transaction accounts or account activity will occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees and expenses disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide an itemized table of all fees and expenses to be paid or payable out of the cash flows from the pool assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate general purpose, party receiving each fee, source of funds, distribution priority; if amount not fixed provide formula used; accompany table with footnotes or narrative disclosing timing, amount, restrictions/limits, how estimates may change (e.g., in event of default), how fees can be changed without notice/approval to security holders and any restrictions on changing fees. Include sufficient explanation for understanding timing/amount.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excess cash flow and retained interest disposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the disposition of residual or excess cash flows and ownership/rights of retained interests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: (1) Identify who owns residual/retained interests and disclose if that person is affiliated with sponsor/depositor/issuing entity or other interested parties, and describe such rights if material. (2) Disclose any transaction requirements to maintain minimum excess cash flow/spread or retained interest and actions/structural changes if requirements not met. (3) Disclose features to facilitate securitization of excess cash flow or retained interest and whether material changes to transaction structure may be made without consent of ABS holders in connection with such securitizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Master trust disclosures (additional series/classes backed by same pool)
rubrics_metrics.description: If one or more additional series or classes have been or may be issued backed by the same asset pool, provide information material to understanding their effect on the securities being offered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (1) relative priority of additional securities and rights to underlying assets/cash flows; (2) allocation of cash flow and expenses/losses among series/classes; (3) terms under which additional series/classes may be issued and pool assets increased/changed; (4) terms of any security holder approval or notification for such issuance; (5) which party has authority to determine issuance and whether independent verification of that authority will occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optional or mandatory redemption or termination features
rubrics_metrics.description: If any class includes an optional or mandatory redemption or termination feature, disclose the terms triggering redemption/termination and related information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (i) terms for triggering; (ii) identity of party holding option/obligation and whether that party is an affiliate of sponsor/depositor/issuing entity or parties in Item 1119(a); (iii) amount or formula for determining redemption/repurchase price; (iv) procedures including notices to security holders; (v) policy regarding recovered amounts after redemption/termination if amounts to holders were reduced by losses. Additionally, titles of classes with optional redemption/termination exercisable when 25% or more of original principal balance remains outstanding must include the word 'callable' (with special master trust series rule).

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepayment, maturity and yield considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe models, sensitivities and allocations relevant to prepayment, maturity and yield for the pool and classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: (1) Describe any models used to identify cash flow patterns and the material assumptions and limitations. (2) Describe degree to which each class is sensitive to changes in payment rates (prepayment/interest rate sensitivity) and consequences, and provide statistical information (effects on yield, weighted average life). (3) Describe any special allocations of prepayment risks among classes and whether any class protects other classes from uncertain timing of cash flows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credit enhancement and other support (excluding certain derivatives)
rubrics_metrics.description: To the extent material, describe credit enhancements or supports designed to affect or ensure timely payment of the asset-backed securities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include (1) external credit enhancement (bond insurance, letters of credit, guarantees), (2) mechanisms ensuring timely payments (liquidity facilities, lending facilities, guaranteed investment contracts, minimum principal payment agreements), (3) derivatives whose primary purpose is to provide credit enhancement related to pool assets or securities, (4) internal credit enhancement from transaction structure (subordination, overcollateralization, reserve/cash collateral/spread accounts). Instructions: describe material terms, limits on timing/amount, conditions to access, file enhancement/support agreement as exhibit, describe substitution provisions. Note: Item should not be construed to allow ABS whose payment is based on anything other than asset performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information regarding significant enhancement providers
rubrics_metrics.description: If an enhancement or support provider is liable or contingently liable to provide payments representing 10% or more of cash flow supporting any offered class, provide descriptive and financial information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Descriptive: name, organizational form, general character of business. Financial: if provider represents >=10% but <20% provide summarized financial information for last three fiscal years; if >=20% provide financial statements meeting S-X requirements (with specified exceptions) and consolidated financials. Instructions: requirements apply to all providers other than those in Item 1115; no information needed if obligations backed by full faith/credit of U.S.; special alternative disclosure for student loan guarantee agencies (specific five-year metrics); foreign business rules for reconciliation to U.S. GAAP or Form 20-F compliance as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derivative instruments altering payment characteristics (Item 1115) — descriptive disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: For derivatives (interest rate, currency swaps, etc.) used to alter payment characteristics whose primary purpose is not credit enhancement, disclose specified descriptive information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe external counterparty (name, organizational form, general character of business), operation/material terms of derivative including limits on timing/amounts or conditions to payments, material provisions regarding substitution, whether the significance percentage is <10%, >=10% and <20%, or >=20%, and file the derivative agreement as an exhibit. Note: 'significance estimate' and 'significance percentage' defined based on reasonable good-faith estimate of maximum probable exposure compared to aggregate principal pool balance (or classes if derivative relates only to classes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial information for derivative counterparties based on significance percentage
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide summarized or full financial information for derivative counterparties when aggregate significance percentage meets thresholds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If aggregate significance percentage for any entity/group providing derivatives is >=10% but <20%, provide summarized financial information per Rule 1-02(bb) for last three fiscal years. If >=20%, provide financial statements meeting Regulation S-X §§210.1-01 through 210.13-02 (with exceptions) and consolidated statements. Instructions: Instructions 2 and 4 to Item 1114(b) apply; Item should not allow ABS payment basis other than pool asset performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tax matters summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a brief, clear and understandable summary of tax-related matters for the ABS transaction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize: (a) the tax treatment of the transaction under federal income tax laws; (b) material federal income tax consequences of purchasing, owning and selling the securities and any material differences among classes; (c) the substance of counsel's tax opinion, including identification of material consequences counsel was not asked or is unable to opine on.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal proceedings material to security holders
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe briefly any legal proceedings pending against the sponsor, depositor, trustee, issuing entity, servicer, originator, or other party that are material to security holders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include similar information for proceedings known to be contemplated by governmental authorities and proceedings of which any property of the foregoing is the subject.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reports required under transaction documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the reports or documents provided to security holders that are required under the transaction agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include information included in reports, schedule and manner of distribution/availability, and the entity/entities that will prepare and provide the reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reports to be filed with the Commission
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the names and, if available, SEC file numbers of entities under which reports about the ABS will be filed with the Commission; identify the reports and other information filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State that the Commission maintains an internet site containing filings (http://www.sec.gov) and provide appropriate identifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Web site access to reports and availability disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether issuing entity reports (Form 10-K, Form 10-D, Form 8-K, and amendments) will be made available on a specified transaction party website and whether other reports to security holders will be made available likewise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If filings will be available on a transaction party website, disclose the web site address. If not, describe reasons and whether an identified transaction party will voluntarily provide electronic or paper copies free of charge upon request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affiliations and related transactions disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe affiliations and certain relationships and related transactions among sponsor, depositor, issuing entity and other material parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize whether and how the sponsor/depositor/issuing entity is an affiliate of servicer, trustee, originator, significant obligor, enhancement provider, any other material parties, or asset representations reviewer. Describe any business relationship/agreement/arrangement outside the ordinary course or on non-arm's-length terms existing or that existed during past two years that is material to an investor's understanding, providing general character of relationships rather than exhaustive lists. Also describe, to the extent material, specific relationships involving or relating to the ABS transaction or pool assets including material terms and approximate dollar amounts. Instruction: For 10-Ks, may omit information to extent substantially same info previously provided in same CIK code filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ratings disclosure requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose whether issuance or sale of any class of offered securities is conditioned on assignment of a rating by one or more rating agencies (NRSROs or others).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If conditioned on ratings, identify each rating agency and the minimum rating that must be assigned and describe any arrangements to have such rating monitored while the securities are outstanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution and pool performance information (periodic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the distribution for the related distribution period and the performance of the asset pool during the distribution period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide appropriate introductory/explanatory information to introduce material terms, parties or abbreviations (or cross-reference another Commission filing). Present statistical information in tabular or graphical format if helpful to understanding.
